name: resume-after-reset-mvp
description: Local desktop plugin for persisted continuation registration, account usage warnings and a usage meter.

interface.longDescription: Account usage meter and direct continuation at the next reset plus one minute. A local macOS service reads usage and queues the saved instruction into the same chat without model inference during setup or waiting. Includes enable, cancel and timer status controls.
defaultPrompt: Enable continuation after the next usage reset in this chat.
When is this chat scheduled to resume?
